messages:
Eli: Partner needs a 30-day window of auth/session SIEM events for a fast vuln audit. They want session_id, result, ts, user. Can we push an export to their S3? Any non-starter for security/compliance?
Tara: We can, but not in clear. Must run through our export-proxy which enforces field removal and per-export tokenization. No unhashed emails or raw IPs for external recipients.
Mohan: Ops: plan is to use envelope encryption: generate ephemeral data key per-export, CMK only wraps. Export proxy has kms:Decrypt permission via kms-proxy role; humans cannot unwrap. Also push objects to partner prefix with a scoped role that only allows PutObject.
Legal: Contract needs a deletion attestation + prohibition on onward distribution. Add a clause that partner must notify us within 48h if they copy or store outside agreed TTL.
Eli: retention mismatch: they asked for 30d but our default retention is 180d. We'll just slice 30d and mark metadata. Is it okay to include a metadata tag with original retention?
Tara: include metadata but avoid user PII in metadata. Add export_id, export_window, scrub_version. Salt must be ephemeral and not persisted beyond export job lifetime. Use SSM ephemeral param with TTL.
Mohan: RBAC details: create iam role arn:aws:iam::acct:role/export-proxy-partner-<name>-write with permissions: s3:PutObject to arn:aws:s3:::partner-bucket/<prefix>/* and kms:Encrypt for CMK wrapping through proxy. Deny s3:GetObject.
Eli: how strict should the scrub rules be? partner expects user hashed, but we sometimes leak agent headers.
Tara: scrub rules: drop headers.*, cookies, auth.token, and redact ip to /24 mask or principal-hash depending on sensitivity. Example scrub snippet: 
```
// scrub pseudo
const allow = ['timestamp','event','result','resource','session_id','userid'];
function scrub(r){ let out = {}; allow.forEach(k=>{ if(r[k]) out[k] = k==='userid' ? hmac(r[k], EXPORT_SALT) : (k==='ip' ? mask24(r[k]) : r[k]); }); return out; }
```
Mohan: note on key revocation: deleting CMK or rotating doesn't guarantee partner deletion. We must delete objects on our side and require partner attestation. Also add an incident_preserve flag: if export is related to an active incident, set preserve=true which prevents scheduled delete for 90d.
Legal: also require partner to accept indemnity for improper disclosure and include proof-of-deletion endpoint usage in SOW.
export-bot: Quick scan: scrub rules check passed, high-risk fields removed, role template lint OK. (reacts :white_check_mark:)
Eli: action items: Mohan create role + kms policy, Tara open PR for scrub lambda + ephemeral salt flow, Legal draft SOW clauses for deletion and indemnity. I'll open the export ticket and flag incident if needed. Thanks.
